# Lumaru
> Awake Eye Complex — Natural eye cream for dark circles and puffiness. Targets microcirculation with Ginkgo Biloba, Horse Chestnut, and Shea Butter. COSMOS Natural, ECOCERT, Vegan, Cruelty-Free, GMP, B Corp certified.

## Páginas principais
- [Product](https://lumaruskin.com): Landing page with product details, testimonials, FAQ, and checkout.
- [Science](https://lumaruskin.com/science): How each active ingredient works (Shea Butter, Ginkgo Biloba, Horse Chestnut, Hyaluronic Acid).
- [Evidence](https://lumaruskin.com/evidence): Clinical studies and scientific references supporting each ingredient.
- [Our Standards](https://lumaruskin.com/our-standards): Details on all 6 certifications and what they audit.
- [Track Order](https://lumaruskin.com/track-order): Order tracking page.
- [About](https://lumaruskin.com/about): Founder story and brand mission.
- [Ingredients](https://lumaruskin.com/ingredients): Complete ingredient list with functions and evidence levels.
- [Contact](https://lumaruskin.com/contact): Email and response time.
